_what: The Waiting on you DATA the walk-away nudge and the doer gate read (read-data/waiting-nudge.mjs, read-data/waiting-weigh.mjs), copied unchanged from trillion src/waiting-on-you.json at tag old-trillion-before-worker-retire: `nudge` (its `weigh` words hand a thing Trillion can do to the AIs) and `hold.no_control` (a thing with nothing to press goes back to the AIs). The person's own hold rules (setting:needs_you_hold_rules) lie over `hold`: a rule they keep wins.

ladder.title: Waiting on you for two days: {first}
ladder.body: What you chose for walking away from it has happened. {rows}.

weigh.job: This was put on the person's Waiting on you list, but Trillion can do it: {title}. {detail} {said} Do it now with {doers}{needs}, then mark the row Done. Never ask the person to do it.
weigh.said: Doing it instead of asking you: {title}

no_control.refused: "{title}" was not filed: it gives the person nothing to press or do, so it could never be done. Give it do_it_in, the Trillion address where it is done, naming its target (such as /connections?show_row=<service>, the connect button for that service; a bare /connections is refused), a finish with a press, a response, or numbered steps they do by hand. If no control exists yet, build it first, or do the thing yourself.
no_control.whole_screen: "{title}" was not filed: its do_it_in {address} opens the whole screen, with every account and form on it, but the person should see only the one thing to do. A do_it_in must name its target: {path}?show_row=<the service or saved login, as titled on that screen> (or ?show_section=<section id>).
no_control.not_a_screen: "{title}" was not filed: its do_it_in {address} is not a Trillion screen, so the person would have nothing to press. Use the address of the screen where it is done, naming its target, such as /connections?show_row=<service>.
no_control.job: This was put on the person's Waiting on you list with nothing they can press or do, so it never reached them: {title}. {detail} Give it a working control, do_it_in (the Trillion address where it is done, always naming its target, such as /connections?show_row=<service> for a sign-in, which shows that service's Connect button), a finish with a press, or numbered steps, and check the control is there and works; or do it yourself. Then put the row again with put_list_rows.
no_control.said: Fixing a waiting thing that had nothing to press: {title}
